scripts.build: bun run embed:check && bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/opencode build && bun run --cwd packages/pi build
scripts.build:tui: bun run embed:check && bun run --cwd packages/opencode build:tui
scripts.typecheck: bun run embed:check && bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/opencode typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/pi typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/e2e-tests typecheck:ga && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test: bun run embed:check && bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun scripts/prepare-common-auth-tests.ts bun test --isolate packages/core/src packages/opencode/src packages/opencode/scripts/build-tui.test.ts packages/pi/src test/ packages/e2e-tests/docker/ga-contract-inputs.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:opencode-v2:local: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/opencode build && bash -c 'root="$(mktemp -d)" && trap "rm -rf \"$root\"" EXIT && ANTIGRAVITY_GA_HOST_EXECUTION=1 bun packages/e2e-tests/src/opencode-ga-harness.ts --run "$root" --inputs packages/e2e-tests/src/opencode-ga-inputs.ts'
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run embed:check && bun run build
scripts.smoke:tui: bun run embed:check && bun run --cwd packages/opencode smoke:tui
